descriptions.before: Calculates a value simulating a critically damped spring.
descriptions.after: Smoothly interpolates a value towards a target, simulating a critically damped spring.
The current value to smooth.
The target value to reach.

descriptions.before: The initial velocity at which the current position should approach the target position.
descriptions.after: The current velocity with which the current value should approach the target value. You shouldn't modify this value between calls yourself, it's used to store the stateful velocity. In most cases, initialize this with 0, zero, zero, or identity depending on the type, or if needed, with your initial velocity.

descriptions.before: The duration in which the total smoothing operation should take place.
descriptions.after: The duration over which the total smoothing operation should take place. Note that since this is a damped spring, there's no guarantee current will be exactly target after this time, but it will be close. Smaller values result in quicker smoothing.

descriptions.before: The maximum speed at which the current position should approach the target position.
descriptions.after: The maximum speed at which the current value should approach the target value. Leaving this nil defaults to huge, meaning the velocity isn't clamped.

descriptions.before: The rate at which the smoothing operation should be applied.
descriptions.after: The rate at which the smoothing operation should be applied. If left nil, the current engine delta time will be used.

descriptions.before: The new position and velocity calculated from the smoothing operation.
descriptions.after: The new value and new velocity calculated from the smoothing operation.
